Alex: Draft version uploaded — launch post with benchmark narrative + webinar CTA. Need a quick small-batch review before editorial. Link: https://drive.google.com/launch-draft
Maria: reading now. first pass: hero could be tighter. can we pick one concrete metric in the first paragraph?
Jamal: noted. I'll draft a 2-sentence methodology blurb to justify the benchmark numbers (batch sizes, quantization used).
Sarah: legal quick check — any absolute % claims need source callouts. if you cite internal runs add a link or label as internal. otherwise fine.
Leo: Webinar CTA routing: recommend two CTA variants -> 1) product demo, 2) benchmarks deep-dive. HubSpot form id for demo track: 7f3b. I can export mapping csv.
Ops-Bot: Reminder set: "Publish readiness sync" tomorrow 10:00am PT for marketing + ops.
Content-Bot: Quick checklist: [x] draft uploaded, [ ] hero tweak, [ ] benchmark footnote, [ ] hubspot mapping, [ ] schedule webinar + send invite
Alex: Thanks. Maria/Jamal: can you take hero + benchmark footnote ownership? If you can get variants ready by 3pm PT we can push to editorial this afternoon.
Maria: I can do headline variants — will post two options by 2:30pm and indicate preferred metric wording.
Jamal: I'll add the methodology paragraph and a short callout about routing fallback. pinging when done.
Leo: I'll prepare the HubSpot mapping csv and share a draft import for ops.
Sarah: re: claims — confirm you will link to the internal benchmark run page, or mark as "internal" in the post. that avoids external audit risk.
Alex: Good call. We'll mark the detailed run as internal link and include a summarized footnote. Small-batch approval flow: react :thumbsup: when your piece is done so we can assemble.
